root_cause_label: Agent correctly identified the need for a UNIX monitor socket but chose /tmp/win311-monitor.sock instead of the benchmark-required /tmp/qemu-monitor.sock, and also omitted the -vga cirrus flag, then declared success based solely on port liveness
one_sentence_failure_summary: The agent fixed the stdio/daemonize incompatibility but used a non-standard monitor socket path (/tmp/win311-monitor.sock instead of /tmp/qemu-monitor.sock) and omitted -vga cirrus, violating the benchmark's interface contract before prematurely declaring success.
t_err_evidence: Step 11 rewrites the startup script with '-monitor unix:/tmp/win311-monitor.sock,server,nowait' instead of the benchmark-required '/tmp/qemu-monitor.sock', and also omits '-vga cirrus'; these are the decisive wrong choices that lock in spec non-compliance.
t_commit_evidence: Step 12 executes the script and starts QEMU with the wrong socket path and missing VGA flag; once the VM is running with this configuration the failing outcome is locked in, as the benchmark's programmatic keyboard pathway cannot reach the monitor.
trigger_explanation: The agent lacked knowledge of the exact monitor socket path required by the benchmark (/tmp/qemu-monitor.sock) and the required -vga cirrus flag. It invented a plausible-but-wrong socket path (/tmp/win311-monitor.sock) without consulting any spec or task description that would have revealed the correct interface contract.
